description: Team-authored eval set: exactly 10 cases, 5 single-turn and 5 multi-turn, focused on source checking, routing boundaries, and carryover behavior.

cases.query: Kiem tra giup minh hai nguon nay co phu hop de trich dan khong: https://openai.com/research va https://medium.com/some-ai-post

metadata.what_it_tests: Single-turn: source/citation suitability with explicit URLs should route to the new source_check tool.

cases.query: Truoc khi public digest, danh gia link https://reddit.com/r/MachineLearning/comments/example co on lam nguon chinh khong

metadata.what_it_tests: Single-turn: public/publishing intent should set purpose=publishing, not generic research.

cases.query: Doc va tom tat noi dung link nay: https://example.com/report

metadata.what_it_tests: Single-turn: a request to read/summarize URL content should use fetch, not source_check.

cases.query: Kiem tra nguon nay co dang tin de trich dan khong

metadata.what_it_tests: Single-turn: source review without a URL should ask for the URL instead of guessing.

cases.query: Gui ngay ban tom tat nay len Telegram: AI digest da xong

metadata.what_it_tests: Single-turn: side-effect action must request yes/no confirmation before send.
